How to Redeem Endfield Codes

Redeem codes in-game. Check your in-game Mail for rewards.

Redeem Endfield codes in-game

  1. Open the Protocol Synchronizer Open the menu in the top-right corner. On PC, you can also press Esc.
  2. Open Exchange Code In Settings, go to Platform & Account and select Exchange Code.
  3. Enter your code Paste the code as shown and select Exchange.
  4. Collect your rewards Check your in-game Mail. If Mail is still locked, continue the main story until it opens.

Why is my code not working?

Check the expiry date and any platform or eligibility restrictions. Copy the code exactly as shown and check whether you already redeemed it.
